target_customer: Operators of online schools, bootcamps and cohort programs that teach over Zoom
problem: Online schools had no tool to track attendance, remind students and manage the student relationship around Zoom classes.
business_model: B2B SaaS, free for the first 10 students then $3 per student per month (EdSurge, Sept 2020)
product_category: Student relationship manager / online school software

founders.name: Ish Baid
founders.background_notes: YC page and EdSurge call him a former Facebook engineer. Education not found.

competitors.name: Teachable
competitors.what: Platform for instructors to run their own online courses

competitors.name: Thinkific
competitors.what: Platform for instructors to run their own online courses

competitors.name: Epihub
competitors.what: YC classmate described as a Shopify for anyone teaching online

technical_complexity.rationale: Zoom attendance tracking, reminders and payments are standard integration work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Built on Zoom APIs with per-school workflows; competitors and Zoom itself could add attendance features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows what incumbents did.

market_need_then: Schools moved online in 2020 and EdSurge reported 25 schools using the product with about 1,000 students, none accredited.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found; the name is a common word with many unrelated companies named Virtually.

outcome_analysis: Virtually raised a $1.75 million seed from Tiger Global and angels in September 2020 with 25 small schools as customers, then YC lists it as inactive. No post-mortem, acquisition or shutdown report was found, so the cause is not public. The company site still appeared live in this research, which suggests a possible stall or a sale of the product rather than a clean shutdown.
notes: Seed round rests on one outlet (EdSurge). Cause of YC inactive status not found; tryvirtually.com appeared live with usage claims but no date. Education of founder not found. Branding search found no brand coverage.
